nodes.description: Public token name string, set in constructor.
Public token symbol string, set in constructor.
Public token decimals (uint8), set to 18 in constructor.
Public total token supply, set in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Constructor initializes name, symbol, decimals, supply and assigns full supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (unchecked subtraction).
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Returns remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from allowed mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on balances.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and decrements allowance using safeSub/safeAdd.
Caller address in constructor, receives full initial supply.
Caller address in approve, becomes allowance owner.
Caller address in transfer, source of debited balance.
Caller address in transferFrom, spender consuming allowance.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
Balance debit operation safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) in transfer.
Balance credit operation safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) in transfer.
Combined balance debit/credit and allowance subtraction updates in transferFrom.
